capabilities: Copy an https LinkOpen link for the current note, heading or block
Wrap an obsidian://open URI in a linkopen.app link
Copy links via commands and right-click menus in the editor and file explorer
Configure open mode (direct open or confirmation page) and copy format (plain or Markdown)
disambiguation: Not a link opener or browser tool; it only copies wrapped obsidian:// links to the clipboard for pasting elsewhere.
extras: Links are URI-encoded, not encrypted, and only open for recipients with the same vault name and matching note path; the plugin itself makes no network requests. README includes a maintainer release procedure.
problem: Plain obsidian:// links are not clickable in many web apps like Notion, Slack, GitHub or Gmail, so sharing a note link outside Obsidian breaks.
summary: Copies the current note, heading or block as an https LinkOpen link that wraps the obsidian:// URI so it stays clickable in Notion, Slack or Gmail.
